text: Recently, we unveiled our vision, an agentic system of work for accounting.
Leading enterprises are racing ahead by automating more than 400 billion worth of transactions
on Maxima without ripping out their ERP.
Today, I'm excited to share our most innovative breakthrough yet.
Max, the 24-7 accountant.
Max is purpose-built for accounting and performs the most painful and recurring prep work for accountants.
Equipped with accounting-specific skills and transactional context, Max executes multi-step workflows end to end.
Working with Max feels like working with another teammate.
It follows a trained accountant's process, applies your accounting policies, checks in when judgment is needed,
and maintains immutable audit trail for every action taken.
Already deployed into production, Max is offloading up to 80% of prep work across a multitude of accounting workflows at tens of millions scale.
Max is helping accountants earn a seat at the table by unlocking their scarce resource, time.
Time for finding the why behind the numbers. Time for launching new pricing models.
And time for getting IPO ready.
Max sits top our agentic system of work, connecting with every transactional system on one side and the ERP on the other.
With Max in the middle, instantly preparing accounting work as transactions occur.
This system has three building blocks.
First, agentic transactional accounting, which automates the heart of accounting work,
gathering data from upstream systems, preparing workbook schedules, generating audit-ready journal entries, and matching every transaction across systems.
Second, agentic close orchestrator, which transforms static close management into agents running every month and task.
From account reconciliation to posting adjustment entries, delivering an exhaustive and accelerated close.
Third, accounting intelligence, which writes variance explanations, prepares reporting packages,
and uncovers anomalies and mavericks spent before it's too late.
Enter the agentic era with one unified system of work for accounting, where Max agent prepares an accountants review.
